notes:
Summary: Horizon Savant is a mid-market KM SaaS (B2B) that provides a hosted knowledge base and AI-driven support tools to SMBs. They plan to replace a multi-stage Elastic + custom reranker with a managed embeddings+rerank pipeline. Primary asks: 1) hosted API with strong 95th pct latency <= 100ms for reranking at 200 QPS, 2) predictable cost per query and tooling to estimate spend for 3M-vector index + monthly churn, 3) SOC2 + SSO, EU data residency assurances for some key customers. 

From AE notes: "We want a drop-in hosted solution — don't want to manage vector infra. Cost is a hard blocker." — CTO (call 1).

POC specifics: running two candidate pipelines on hosted API: (A) single-stage dense-retrieval + rerank (our baseline), (B) hybrid BM25 + embeddings retrieval + lightweight rerank. A showed better latency, B slightly better recall at top-5. Need to run larger scale tests (1M+ vectors) to validate production tail latency.

Operational constraints: high QPS bursts (200-250 qps sustained per region during EMEA business hours), typical query size small (avg 64 tokens), want auto-batching but with routing control for latency-sensitive routes. Finance asked for modeled monthly bill at 150 QPS baseline — awaiting Redwood costing model for hosted_api + optimize suggestions.

Open items / next steps: 1) SE to run 3M vector POC with representative dataset and provide token-level cost estimate; 2) Security to provide SOC2 docs + data residency (EU) mapping; 3) AE to align forecast with procurement timeline (legal procurement in March).
